title: docs(blog): link the English deck PDF from the end of 'The Ontology Is the Software'
body:
立卡门类别 ③ — 维护者直派的任务 (maintainer-directed task).

## Maintainer ruling (verbatim, untranslated)

> 合并 PR #22254，然后把 PDF 链接加到博客文章末尾

Given in session https://claude.ai/code/session_011hRnra93sK5Q2gTYYTbdJR on 2026-10-08. The first half is #22253 / PR #22254 (the deck PDF under `apps/docs/public/decks/`, in the merge queue). This card is the second half.

## What lands

One addition at the end of `content/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software.mdx`, after the existing *Further reading* paragraph: a one-line *As a talk* note linking the deck, "The Ontology Is the Software — How a large model reads an enterprise", 17 slides, PDF. Nothing else on the page changes: no prose edit, no frontmatter change, no date change.

## Link form, and why

The link is written as the absolute site URL, https://objectstack.ai/decks/the-ontology-is-the-software.pdf, not the root-relative `/decks/...`. Reason, measured in `.github/workflows/check-links.yml`: the Check Documentation Links lane runs lychee `--offline` with `--root-dir` pointing at `content/`, so a root-relative link resolves to `content/decks/...`, which does not exist, and the lane goes red; an http(s) link is EXCLUDED by `--offline` and never requested. The PDF is served from `apps/docs/public/`, outside the content root, so the absolute form is the only one that is both correct on the site and green in the gate. The docs app serves `apps/docs/public/decks/the-ontology-is-the-software.pdf` at that URL once PR #22254 merges.

## Guardrails

- One file, `content/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software.mdx`, one added paragraph. No `packages/**`, no `apps/docs/**`, no README.
- Nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.
- No model identifiers.
- Gates derived with `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` from the real change set and run before pushing.
- Seat-executed (the same reasoning as #22253: a one-paragraph edit the maintainer asked for directly). Landed through the merge queue on the maintainer's instruction above.

## Duplicate check (2026-10-08, open and closed)

- Query "blog essay link to slide deck PDF further reading the ontology is the software": 6 hits — #22253 (the PDF itself, in flight), #21838 (the essay, closed), #22240 (compare and when-to-use, closed), #21574, #22172, #21586 (positioning work, closed). None links a deck from the essay.
